name: Erebus: The Northwest Passage
storyline:
In 1845, Sir John Franklin led an expedition through the Arctic ocean. His mission: to find the legendary "Northwest Passage" through the Arctic that would provide a shortcut between the Atlantic and Pacific oceans. It didn't go well.

As captain aboard one of Franklin's ships, you have the job of picking up the pieces and trying to get your crew out of this mess in one piece. But it gets worse. As if trying to determine what tasks needed to be done in sub-zero temperatures weren't enough, you've also got to deal with monsters and an imposter who will actively sabotage your efforts. Have fun!
summary: Lead the doomed 1845 Franklin Expedition through the Arctic in a survival strategy game where every month, order, resource, officer, and event can decide the fate of HMS Erebus and her crew.
